prose.summary: The product does not meet the rule of origin, so the normal (MFN) rate applies. The main failed check is that final manufacture did not take place in the UAE.
prose.classification: The product is classified under tariff line 85044030, Battery chargers, with high confidence. The code should be confirmed with Indian customs or a customs broker before shipping.
prose.duty: Under the India-UAE CEPA, the normal (MFN) rate is 20% and the CEPA rate is 0%. Since the product does not qualify for the CEPA rate, no duty saving applies.
prose.origin: The rule of origin requires a change in tariff heading (CTH) and at least 40% value addition (VA). The final manufacture check failed because the last manufacturing step did not take place in the UAE, and the minimal operations check failed because only simple operations (b), (k), (l) under Art. 3.5.1 were performed. The CTH check failed because one non-originating input in heading 8504 accounted for 88.0% of the price, exceeding the 10% de minimis limit. The VA check failed because the build-down value addition was only 12.0%, below the 40% threshold on an FOB basis.
